name: plate_zombie
prompt: Edit this image into its ZOMBIE NIGHT version for a bonus round. Keep the exact same composition, camera, layout, cartoon style, every object in the same place and the same size, so it lines up with the original: the canopy with the FALCOS neon sign, the black SUV, the pump, the store with the blue FALCOS fascia and the big window on the right. Change: the gas station is now ABANDONED - cracked and peeling paint, rust streaks, boarded-up glass door, cracked window glass, the blue fascia dented and faded with one letter hanging loose, weeds through the cracked wet concrete, litter, the firewood scattered, cobwebs, one canopy light broken and dark, a sickly green fog low on the ground, an eerie green-teal moonlit sky with a big full moon. The FALCOS neon sign is half broken and glows a sick toxic green-red. The woman leaning on the SUV is now a funny cartoon ZOMBIE in the same pose with the same blonde hair (now messy) and the same clothes (torn), green-grey skin, stitches, glowing eyes, still holding a smoking cigarette. The cashier in the window is now a funny cartoon ZOMBIE in the same pose behind the counter in his torn red FALCOS shirt, green skin, moustache, glowing eyes, still handing over change; the customer is a zombie too. Spooky but fun, family-friendly cartoon zombies, not gory. Same bold ink outlines and cel shading.

name: plate_nitro
prompt: Edit this image into its NITRO STREET-RACE version for a bonus round. Keep the exact same composition, camera, layout, cartoon style and every object in the same place and size so it lines up with the original: the canopy with the FALCOS neon sign, the black SUV, the pump, the store with the blue FALCOS fascia and the big window on the right. Change: it is a midnight street-race night at the gas station - electric-blue and purple neon light everywhere, the FALCOS neon sign now glows electric blue, glowing blue underglow beneath the SUV, flame decals and chrome nitro tanks on the SUV, blue nitro flames shooting from the pump nozzle holder, speed streaks of light across the sky, checkered-flag bunting hanging from the canopy, a starting-light tree on a pole, tyre smoke drifting low across the wet ground that reflects blue and pink. The woman leaning on the SUV is in the same pose wearing a racing jacket and holding a checkered flag instead of the cigarette, grinning. The cashier in the window is in the same place in a race-team shirt with FALCOS on it, cheering with a stopwatch in his hand; the customer wears a racing cap. Exciting, high energy, same bold ink outlines and cel shading. No other text.
